'''Shoo''', '''Minda''' and '''Nye''' are the three constituent dialects of a [[Jukunoid language]]<ref>{{Glottolog|shoo1247|Shoo-Minda-Nye}}</ref> of [[Nigeria]] which has no unitary name.

Minda is spoken widely by the people who live in Minda, in present day Lau Local Government Area of [[Taraba State]].
